title: Image Pad
text: Pad image by adding rows, columns, or both, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Method} sets Padding method; {Pad value source} sets the source of constant pad value Specify via, {Pad value}, {Specify} sets the padding size specification format, {Add columns to} sets the column padding location, {Output column mode} sets the output column sizing, {Number of output columns} sets the number of columns in output image, {Number of added columns} sets the number of columns added to input image, {Add rows to} sets the row padding location, {Output row mode} sets the output row sizing, {Number of output rows} sets the number of rows in output image, {Number of added rows} sets the number of rows added to input image and {Action when truncation occurs} sets the action when input signal is truncated. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Method
params.values: Padding method Constant (default) | Replicate | Symmetric | Circular

params.name: Pad value source
params.values: Source of constant pad value Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Specify
params.values: Padding size specification format Pad size (default) | Output size

params.name: Add columns to
params.values: Column padding location Left (default) | Right | Both left and right | No padding

params.name: Output column mode
params.values: Output column sizing method User-specified (default) | Next power of two

params.name: Number of output columns
params.values: Number of columns in output image 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of added columns
params.values: Number of columns added to input image 2 (default) | positive integer | two-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Add rows to
params.values: Row padding location Top (default) | Bottom | Both top and bottom | No padding

params.name: Output row mode
params.values: Output row sizing method User-specified (default) | Next power of two

params.name: Number of output rows
params.values: Number of rows in output image 12 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of added rows
params.values: Number of rows added to input image [2 3] (default) | positive integer | two-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Action when truncation occurs
params.values: Action when input signal is truncated None (default) | Warning | Error
